title: Wine Tasting & Picnic Winery Tour
text: The most beautiful activity we have done in Barcelona. Such friendly people with love and passion on giving you the experience of your life. They helped me prepare the perfect engagement.  we got a picnic at the top of the hill which offered us an amazing view of Alella city and vineyards. would definitely recommend to anyone seeking a private romantic tour or even a great family experience. thank you Laura and Melanie for making our special day so unique! a real dream come true :)
author: julienravart
